checks: stable loader reads current manifest and runs the selected immutable release
same loader follows a later release without changing the saved command
invalid manifest versions cannot change host or inject a path
unsupported game or missing compiler makes no update download
manifest failure does not silently run an old release
HTML fallback and oversized source are rejected
compile and startup errors stay visible without another execution
update check shows GUI notification once without credentials or executing code
current and older releases hide the notice; version ordering is numeric
manifest error remains retryable and subsequent check restores the notice
late update response after client shutdown does not update the GUI
stopped client does not send update checks
scope: Actual stable loader, update-check and GUI indicator functions with stubbed HTTP/game objects on Luau CLI; no real game execution.
